name: Chimera

actions.name: Goat Horns
actions.effect: Target must pass PHYS save or be knocked prone.

actions.name: Dragon Head Breath
actions.effect: A 5m cone of fire. All targets must pass PHYS save for half damage. Recharges on a roll of 5-6 at start of turn.

reactions.name: Triple Awareness
reactions.effect: The Chimera cannot be surprised and has +2d6 to saves against being flanked or ambushed. When attacked from behind, the goat head retaliates for 2d8 bludgeoning.

traits.name: Three Heads
traits.desc: The Chimera has advantage on perception checks and saves against being blinded, deafened, or stunned.

traits.name: Flyby
traits.desc: Can fly using its dragon wings. Does not provoke reactions when flying out of reach.

lore: Chimeras are grotesque three-headed monstrosities combining a lion, goat, and dragon. They are savage, destructive, and territorial, swooping from mountain lairs to ravage livestock and settlements. Their dragon head's breath weapon makes them particularly dangerous.
